description: Free lint of an AI agent's function-calling tool definitions (OpenAI format): finds missing or vague descriptions, untyped or undocumented parameters, undeclared required fields and date fields without a format. Use when someone builds or debugs an agent that calls tools.

tools.description: Up to 12 tool definitions in OpenAI function format: {name, description, parameters}. Never include secrets.

description.description: Tool description shown to the model.

name.description: Tool name as the model sees it.

parameters.description: JSON Schema of the tool arguments.

name: check_tool_schemas
title: Check tool schemas (free)
